question: How does the all-pervading lord preside over the five causes?
premises: Through Samanā the all-pervading lord presides.
He presides over the five causes.
He always presides over the unsupported lord Ananta, whose body is space.
inference: The all-pervading lord, through Samanā, continually presides over the five causes and over the unsupported lord Ananta, whose body is space.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the five causes is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Through her the all-pervading lord presides over the five causes, and he always presides over this unsupported lord Ananta, whose body is space.
